Jordan Avery
jordan.avery@example.com
Bristol, UK
https://example.com/jordan-avery
Summary
PRODUCT MANAGER | B2B WORKFLOWS & PLATFORM OPERATIONS
Product manager with experience in enterprise workflow software, partner integrations and service operations. Combines customer research with delivery planning to make complex processes easier to understand and operate. Has worked across product and design roles, translating user needs into clear requirements, practical controls and measurable improvements. Comfortable collaborating with engineering, commercial and support teams throughout discovery, launch and iteration.
Experience
Bayline Systems
Product Manager
May 2020 - Sep 2025
Owned workflow capabilities for a fictional enterprise service platform, working with engineering, customer teams and partner organizations from discovery through rollout.
Product strategy and customer workflows
Owned the roadmap for customer onboarding, approval workflows and account administration, balancing user research findings with technical dependencies, delivery capacity and commercial priorities.
Interviewed customer administrators and support specialists to identify recurring handoff problems; translated findings into requirements, acceptance criteria and a prioritized sequence of product improvements.
Worked with engineering through planning, specification review and release validation, maintaining a clear record of decisions and following up on customer feedback after each rollout.
Permissions and approval design
Designed a role-based permission model for account owners, supervisors and operators, making access boundaries visible and reducing ambiguity in common administration and approval tasks.
Reworked exception handling for incomplete submissions and rejected approvals, giving users clear next actions while preserving an audit trail for customer service and internal review.
Introduced configurable approval routes for different customer teams, testing edge cases with operations specialists before expanding the capability to additional accounts and workflows.
APIs and partner integrations
Led requirements for partner APIs covering account setup, request status and activity records, including error handling, retry behavior and documentation for integration teams.
Worked with two fictional software partners on integration pilots, capturing failure scenarios and turning findings into clearer API contracts, support guidance and release criteria.
Created a shared integration checklist covering permissions, sample requests, environment configuration and operational ownership so delivery teams could prepare launches with fewer missing dependencies.
Reporting and operational tooling
Built reporting requirements for request volume, turnaround time and exception rates, helping customer administrators identify bottlenecks and compare performance across their own service teams.
Designed internal tools for reviewing activity records, investigating failed requests and managing notifications, with clear access controls and documented escalation paths for support specialists.
Establishing a consistent event taxonomy improved the usefulness of product dashboards and gave the team a clearer basis for prioritizing follow-up research and workflow changes.
Earlier design responsibility
Designed navigation and form patterns for the web platform, considering accessibility and common customer administration tasks.
Created reusable workflow guidance and reviewed implementation with engineering to maintain consistency as the platform expanded.
Harbor Tools
Product Designer
Feb 2016 - Apr 2020
Designed enterprise service workflows covering assignment, review and communication between customer administrators and delivery teams.
Used usability findings to improve navigation, form completion and request status visibility.
Documented interaction patterns and supported product discovery, specifications and implementation review.
Clearway Software
UX Designer
Jul 2012 - Jan 2016
Designed business account-management and reporting interfaces using customer interviews to clarify common tasks.
Collaborated with engineering to improve onboarding and consistency across frequently used screens.
Prepared prototypes, specifications and implementation reviews, documenting release decisions.
Education
MSc Human Computer Interaction
Fictional Northbridge University
2010-2012
BA Design
Fictional Westmere College
2006-2010
Skills
Product Management: Customer research, roadmaps, prioritization, requirements, launch planning and iteration.
Enterprise Workflows: Onboarding, approvals, account administration and exception handling.
Platform Integrations: API requirements, partner pilots and integration documentation.
Design: Interaction design, prototypes, usability testing and accessibility review.
Data and Operations: Dashboards, service metrics, activity records and support workflows.
Languages: English professional working proficiency; French conversational proficiency.
